summary: glibc: buffer overflow in ld.so while processing GLIBC_TUNABLES
details:
A buffer overflow was discovered in the GNU C Library's dynamic loader
ld.so while processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable. This issue
could allow a local attacker to use maliciously crafted GLIBC_TUNABLES
environment variables when launching binaries with SUID permission to execute
code with elevated privileges.

database_specific.pengyos_fixture_note:
NVD lists the upstream fix in glibc 2.39; this
  fixture deliberately keeps the pin (2.39) inside the vulnerable range
  (fixed 2.40) so the pipeline demonstrates an affected core component.
